integrity: The proof derives the rational generating function and normal limit analytically; the included checker independently validates finite exact cases but cannot certify all n.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted two-rail ladder only. The central limit is asymptotic, without a stated Berry-Esseen constant. Earlier full rung-gap construction can support derivation of the leaf statistic; historical priority remains unverified.
title: An exact leaf-count law and Gaussian fluctuations for ladder spanning trees
